tldr: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 appeared as a name before any model shipped, on Oct 16. The same day, a report said China's planned export license for new large AI models could affect its unreleased launch.
whats_new: TestingCatalog reports Kimi K3.1 is being prepared for release after Arena testing, and a Kimi K3.1 Pro explainer on benchmarks and pricing followed the same day.
why_it_matters: A possible export-license requirement plus an unreleased model means availability, API access and pricing for K3.1 are unconfirmed, so it is not yet a safe dependency.

status.detail: K3.1 is reportedly in Arena testing and nearing release; no confirmed official launch appears in these items.

beats.headline: Kimi K3.1 named before any model is available
beats.summary: An OrcaRouter piece contrasts the name with the absence of a released model.

beats.headline: China export-license plan could hit unreleased K3.1
beats.summary: Wccftech says all new large AI models would need a license, potentially affecting Moonshot.

beats.headline: Arena testing done, release being prepared
beats.summary: Release-prep report and a Pro-tier benchmarks and pricing guide arrive Oct 23.

open_questions: Does Moonshot publish an official K3.1 release date and API availability?
Does the export license requirement apply to K3.1, and does it limit access outside China?
Do independent benchmarks confirm the K3.1 Pro numbers in the pricing guide?
Are K3.1 weights released openly or API-only?
take_for_builders: Do not wire K3.1 into production yet; keep your current model as fallback and rerun your own evals once Moonshot confirms availability, pricing and license terms.
